biggest_catch: UNiDAYS is a free discount platform with no single exact discount — retailer offers vary, so it fails the user's exact-discount rule despite having clear access terms.
catches: Official UNiDAYS FAQ confirms the access terms: current students join free, verify status, receive 12 months of access, and re-verify every 12 months.
But there is no single exact discount percentage — every retailer sets its own offer, which varies and changes.
The user's bar requires a concrete, currently live official offer with an exact discount/price — a platform of varying third-party offers cannot meet it.
This is savings, not income — and the savings amount is never fixed.

c1.evidence: UNiDAYS is a real company; official FAQ on myunidays.com confirms free student access terms.

c2.evidence: No single exact discount/price — retailer offers vary; fails the exact-discount rule.

c3.evidence: Joining is free for students; no participation fee.

eligibility: Current students who verify status; 12 months of access per verification, re-verify every 12 months.
